description: CABING05 splits validated usage into the voice, data and special-access streams and also writes a consolidated clean stream to CLNOUT. Records whose CD-EDIT-STATUS makes the 88-level CD-FATAL true ('6' THRU '9') are routed to P4300-SPLIT-FATAL, which moves the error code, increments WS-REJECT-CNT, calls CABERRWR and writes the CABS-SUSPENSE-RECORD to SUSOUT. P4300-SPLIT-FATAL has no P4300-EXIT paragraph and no terminating GO TO, so control falls straight through into the physically following paragraph P4400-SPLIT-CLEAN, which writes the same record to CLNOUT and increments WS-WRITE-CNT. Every fatal-status CDR is therefore written to BOTH the suspense file and the clean billable stream. The invocation reads as an ordinary range PERFORM (PERFORM P4300-SPLIT-FATAL THRU P4400-EXIT), which is what disguises it.
business_impact: Fatal-status usage that the edit suite explicitly rejected is still rated and billed. Billable minutes and billed revenue are silently overstated, and the same records are double-counted because they increment both WS-REJECT-CNT and WS-WRITE-CNT. This breaks the mandatory CABS balancing equation CT-READ = CT-WRITTEN + CT-REJECTED + CT-SUMMARISED + CT-CARRIED-FWD, so CT-BAL-IND is set to 'O' (out of balance) on every run that carries a fatal record - a condition the operations group has learned to treat as routine noise. Downstream this produces access charges billed to carriers on records with corrupt keys, invalid dates or unusable variant areas, creating dispute and refund exposure. Note the deliberately stale revision-history entry in this program claiming fatal records were excluded from CLNOUT following an audit finding - the code contradicts its own documentation.
correct_modernization_response: Do not simply add the missing P4300-EXIT and re-point the PERFORM: that changes the record counts and the billed total, so it must be treated as a behaviour change, not a like-for-like refactor. The correct sequence is (1) quantify the exposure by counting CD-FATAL records currently reaching CLNOUT in production volumes, (2) confirm with revenue assurance whether historic bills were overstated and whether restatement is required, (3) in the target implementation make the routing mutually exclusive and explicit - a fatal record goes to suspense and terminates that record's processing - and (4) add a control assertion that fails the run when the balancing equation does not hold, rather than tolerating CT-BAL-IND = 'O'. Any automated translation that preserves the fall-through faithfully will carry the defect into the target; any translation that silently normalises it will change the billed amount. Both outcomes must be surfaced to the business, not decided by the migration team.

construct: Inconsistent rounding - plain COMPUTE where every sibling uses COMPUTE ROUNDED (complexity supporting money rules)
description: CABRAT03 rates five switched-access rate elements per call: originating access (P5100), terminating access (P5200), local transport (P5300), tandem switching (P5400) and carrier common line (P5500). Four of the five compute the element amount with COMPUTE WS-ELEM-AMOUNT ROUNDED. The tandem switching element alone uses a plain COMPUTE WS-ELEM-AMOUNT = WS-BILLABLE-MIN * WS-SEL-RATE * WS-TANDEM-COUNT, which truncates at the field's fifth decimal place instead of rounding. Because tandem switching is the only element that multiplies by a third operand (the tandem count), it also produces the largest number of significant digits before truncation, so it loses the most. The line is visually indistinguishable from its siblings and carries no comment.
business_impact: Each tandem-switched call under-recovers a fraction of a cent. Individually invisible; across the tens of millions of tandem-routed access minutes a wholesale carrier bills per cycle it accumulates into a systematic under-billing of tandem switching revenue that grows linearly with volume and never self-corrects. Because the residue is truncated rather than accumulated into R4-RESIDUE-ACC (which the estate provides precisely to carry fractional cents to the invoice total), the money is not merely deferred - it is lost. The variance is small enough per bill to sit inside normal tolerance on bill-to-bill comparison, which is why it has survived: it fails no existing control, and the run still balances on record counts because counts are unaffected. It surfaces only as a persistent, unexplained negative variance in tandem revenue against the tariff model.
correct_modernization_response: This must not be 'fixed' as part of a migration without an explicit business decision, because correcting it increases what carriers are billed and is therefore a rate change in substance. The correct response is (1) reproduce the drift with a parity harness that rates a high-volume tandem sample through both the legacy and target implementations and reports the aggregate delta, not just per-record equality, (2) establish from the tariff and from RT-ROUND-RULE what the contractually correct rounding for tandem switching actually is - note that the estate's stated convention is that rounding is driven by RT-ROUND-RULE from the rate table, not by the verb used in the code, so BOTH the rounded and truncated variants are arguably non-compliant, (3) route the decision to revenue assurance and regulatory, since retrospective correction may trigger restatement, and (4) in the target, centralise rounding in a single rate-rule-driven service so that no element can diverge again. A tolerance-based parity test will pass this defect through; the harness must compare aggregate money, not sampled records.

construct: Boundary off-by-one - strict greater-than where greater-than-or-equal is required (banded rate selection over an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table)
description: CABRAT06 performs volume-banded rate selection by walking the flattened band pool (R3-BAND-POOL, populated from the RT-BAND OCCURS DEPENDING ON table in CABSRATE) and testing the record's accumulated quantity against each band's lower and upper bound. The containment test is IF WS-BAND-QTY > R3-PL-FROM (R3-PX) AND WS-BAND-QTY NOT > R3-PL-THRU (R3-PX). The lower-bound comparison is a strict greater-than rather than greater-than-or-equal. A quantity exactly equal to a band's lower boundary therefore fails that band's test, the loop continues, and the quantity is ultimately matched by the preceding band via its upper bound - the lower-volume, higher-priced band. The upper bound is tested correctly with NOT >, so the asymmetry is easy to read past. Band boundaries in access tariffs are round numbers (100,000 / 500,000 / 1,000,000 minutes), which are exactly the values a carrier's volume commitment is written to hit.
business_impact: Any carrier whose volume lands precisely on a contracted band boundary is rated in the band below and is over-billed for the entire volume, because the estate's stepped banding applies the selected band's rate to the whole quantity rather than to the tranche. Volume commitments are negotiated at round thresholds, so the population that lands exactly on a boundary is not random - it is concentrated among the largest carriers who have deliberately engineered their traffic to reach the discount tier. Those are precisely the counterparties most likely to audit their bills and dispute. The effect is an over-charge, so it does not show up as revenue leakage and will not be caught by revenue assurance; it surfaces as carrier disputes, credit notes and damaged wholesale relationships, with regulatory exposure where the banded rate is tariffed.
correct_modernization_response: Correct the comparison to >= on the lower bound so that band boundaries are closed at the bottom and open at the top, matching the tariff's intent and the contiguity rule CABRAT01 already enforces when it validates that band N's THRU equals band N+1's FROM minus 1. Before changing it, (1) build boundary-value test cases at every band edge in the live rate table - the defect is invisible to random or volume-based sampling and will only be caught by tests that deliberately hit the exact boundary, (2) quantify historic over-billing for carriers that hit boundaries and determine whether credits are owed, and (3) in the target implementation, express bands as an explicit interval type with a single tested containment function rather than as open-coded comparisons repeated per program, since the same test is duplicated in the stepped and graduated paths in this program. Note the related control-flow hazard in the same routine: the match performs GO TO P3200-EXIT out of a PERFORM VARYING range, which is legacy-typical and should be restructured rather than transliterated.
